title: DUTIES AND POWERS OF COMMISSIONER OF BUILDINGS
officialText:
104.1 General. The commissioner shall have the authority to render interpretations of this code
and to adopt rules, policies and procedures in order to clarify and implement its provisions. Such
interpretations, policies, procedures, and rules shall be in compliance with the intent and purpose
of this code. See the Charter and Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code for additional
provisions relating to the authority of the commissioner of buildings.
